description: with kmonad running and '(defsrc f9)', an unlisted 'a' from the VM kernel keyboard reaches the probe unchanged through kmonad's uinput-sink; Hyprland finds no bind and the Input remapper layer does not redirect it
setup: dev=$(grep -l 'QEMU Virtio Keyboard' /sys/class/input/event*/device/name | head -1 | cut -d/ -f5) && test -n "$dev" && sed -i "s|EVDEV|/dev/input/$dev|" /root/kmonad.kbd
